'''Tenn ''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] stationed on the war torn [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] around [[3642 BBY]]. During that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he tasked a traveling [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] hero to [[Death/Legends|kill]] a [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoid]] queen in an overrun [[Balmorran resistance]] base that was causing issues to the Republic military front on the planet with insurances and was known for lightning fast strikes.

==Behind the scenes==
Tenn first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' for Republic classes in the heroic mission Local Predators.
